scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
恭喜。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Heh...
It's tough
being a hero
and being shady,
untrustworthy,
sneaky...
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
嘿...
既要当英雄，又要鬼鬼祟祟、让人信不过、偷偷摸摸...
真不容易啊。

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
But when the
going gets rough
my pals know they
can count on me.
I need them and
they need me.
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
不过，遇到难关，伙伴们都知道可以信赖我。
我需要他们，他们也需要我。

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
This world needs
more heroes who are
willing to walk the line
between order and lawlessness.
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
这个世界需要更多愿意游走在秩序与法外之间的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Are you ready
to join the ranks
of the sneakiest of
warriors? Are you ready
to become a Stalker?
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
准备好加入最擅长潜行的战士行列了吗？
你准备好成为神行太保了吗？

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
准备好了，随时回来吧。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
你还有可以学习的技能。
请用完剩余的技能点，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Congratulations!
As a Stalker, I hope
you stab the right people
in the back. Banish the
wicked using their own
dastardly methods!
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
恭喜！
愿你身为神行太保，把背后的刀刺向该刺的人。
以恶人的卑鄙手段，除掉恶人！

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
在这里安心休息吧。
向战士们致敬！
